description: Track the Debian release the Docker base image is built on.

gradle/libs.versions.toml pins it as `debian`, and .github/docker/Dockerfile interpolates it into the image *name* — gcr.io/distroless/java-base-debian13 — so the release is not a tag Renovate could follow on that image. It is followed on the debian image instead.

distroless publishes one variant per Debian release, so a bump is only valid once java-base-debian<release> exists; nothing on a pull request builds the image, so that has to be checked by hand before merging.
The versioning admits whole releases only: debian also tags point releases (13.6) and codenames (trixie), and neither names a distroless variant.
